report:
# FQ-GAP-REAL-EMBEDDING-CHOICE

Source evalAtS=4a+b*s at s=±9 gives an effective sqrt5 value ±9/4, whose square differs from5 by1/16. It is not a real field embedding. New exact coefficients use Q(sqrt5), an actual conditional real root s>0,s²=5, and isolating interval(2,3). Pure rank-one Gram forms remain PSD under either root choice; mixed diag(s-2,3-s) is positive at the positive root and fails at the conjugate. Totient arithmetic gives phi(120)=32 and half32=16, without claiming a proved cyclotomic field identification.

Supported: Exact quadratic-field Gram/conjugate coefficients, a mixed signature control and real-root inequalities are checked; the fake 9/4 root is explicitly rejected.

Remaining: Formalize the coefficient-to-real embedding homomorphisms, full Gram PSD and cyclotomic fixed-field degree identification. A declared evaluation is not that embedding.
